# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight lad. He has a round face that is devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Barney is an emotionless young man who possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter. He suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Despite his quiet nature, he harbors a vast admiration for Nell and takes immense pride in being in her presence.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- inability to hold a conversation  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- driving a carriage  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Barney and his sister Odette drove a double-seated buggy to pick up Nell and Isolde for a concert trip to Pale Sands. Upon arrival, he demanded that Nell sit beside him on the front seat, feeling immense pride to travel alongside her.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_
